title: Earl Hines's Grand Terrace band personnel and the end of reel 1
summary: They list sidemen of Hines's band such as Quinn Wilson, Omer Simeon and Cecil Erwin, and Erwin's fatal accident; the first reel ends.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: So we were talking about Chicago and the Grand Terrace, and that was when Earl Hines was in the Grand Terrace with that great band he had with Billie Franklin and all those guys, Cecil Erwin and Quinn Wilson. when I had
No, he Quinn was there. And George Dixon, Walter Fuller on drums. (Ed. note- Fuller on trumpet)
Remember that little huchback, the trumpet player, Mitch?
He was one of the first trumpet players I remember there.
Cecil Erwin was on tenor, as you mentioned, and Omer Simeon was lead alto, and what a band that was. And then Jimmy Mundy came in later.
And they had a terrible accident in which Cecil Erwin got killed out there.
I think that was when Budd Johnson joined the band.
